headline: It scores what the notes actually demonstrate, using @typesafeai's Jev.

media.alt: Video from the post by Paperplaneflyr

text:
Long notes scored 82. I deleted most of the notes and the same topic scored 50, with 99% confidence. 

That is the point of Knowledge Signal. It does not grade you. It scores what the notes actually demonstrate, using @typesafeai's Jev.

Five lenses: conceptual depth, accuracy,…
